[SWS_CRYPT_00502]
{DRAFT}
⌈
If a
ara::crypto::cryp::RandomGenera-
torCtx
uses global state or local state without support for user-provided seed/en-
tropy, calls to its methods
ara::crypto::cryp::RandomGeneratorCtx::Seed
,
ara::crypto::cryp::RandomGeneratorCtx::SetKey
and
ara::crypto::
cryp::RandomGeneratorCtx::AddEntropy
shall return
kUnsupported
without
modifying the global state or local state.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02206)
